route.rationale: New coordination core crate plus a herdr backend, a Rust replacement for control-loop.sh, and the repair of a dead spawn line. cross-platform: Linux and Windows are both required outcomes. multi-domain: a new crate, the bee-herding skill references, a shell script replacement, and the knowledge bundle. public-contracts: the bee CLI grows verbs. No hard-gate territory — no auth, authorization, data-model, audit-security, external-systems, or proof-weakening. One named risk holds it at standard rather than small: control-loop.sh constructs the control pane --allowedTools surface and the working agent --permission-mode bypassPermissions tail, so its Rust replacement must produce byte-identical argv to the bash default, proven by test, or the recorded permission-posture split (herding-adopt D7) drifts silently.
